images.alt: The attached image shows Queenstown at 8:00 am on 1 July 2026. You can see the ground looking nice and crunchy underfoot! 🥶(white coat over the usually green grass)

post.text:
❄️FROST ❄️ 

Queenstown was one of many places to experience frost overnight. The air temperature (measured around 1.5 metres above the ground) dropped to -3°C overnight. Meanwhile, the grass temperature (measured around 5 cm above the ground) fell even lower, reaching -5°C.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
